description: Implement `write_notice`: inside `directory`, create a file named `NOTICE_FILENAME` and write exactly `strlen(NOTICE_TEXT)` bytes of the macro `NOTICE_TEXT` (both from `config.h`) using the Win32 API (`CreateFileA`/`WriteFile`), without the NUL terminator. Join the directory and filename with a backslash. Return 0 on success and -1 on failure.
name: write_notice
